feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 27 May 2026 6:00am
items.description:
##Today##

Fine again, but rather windy in many places later in evening/ for a time overnight. Still quite warm. Risk of showers developing overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 21°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

East 10-15, 15-20 in places, increasing East or SE 15-20 in evening, 20-25 in places, then possibly 30 gusts 40 in a few upland spots and around parts of the west coast for a time overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Tomorrow##

Any showers at first will quickly clear leaving the rest of the morning dry and sunny. However, the afternoon and evening will become cloudier at times with a risk of mist on the hills and around some coasts. Dry overnight as any mist clears.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

East or SE 15-20 at first, 20-25 in places, but soon decreasing SE 10-15, 15-20 in places. Gradually veering and South or SW later in day.


##Visibility##

Good, but poor in mist. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places at first.


##Friday, 29 May 2026##

Dry with sunny/ clear intervals.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 10-15, 15-20 in places at first, backing South later.


##Visibility##

Good. Patchy hill fog at first and later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 30 May 2026##

Dry with sunny intervals, but soon turning cloudier with outbreaks of rain arriving around early afternoon, these clearing late in day/ overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

South 10-15, increasing 15-20 in places, veering West or SW later in day/ overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

The beginning of a more unsettled spell.


##Sunday, 31 May 2026##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers. Rain arriving towards end of night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

West or SW 10-15, 15-20 in places, backing South later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain late. Hill fog late.


##Comments##

Nil.
